summary: The root "lyn" describes something that is soft, gentle, or pliable. It can refer to physical softness, a smooth surface, or a gentle disposition.
lane: 1 لَانَ ذ , inf. n. لِينٌ [not لَيْنٌ as in the CK] and لَياَنٌ , (T, S, M, K,) contr. of خَشُنَ ; (S, K in art. خشن , and TK;) It was, or became, soft, as opposed to rough or harsh; smooth; plain; without asperities; fine to the touch; delicate; tender; supple; lithe; limber; pliant; pliable; flexible; ductile; malleable; soft, or flabby; lax: and he was, or became, soft; tender; pliant; gentle; bland; or mild. Hence لان جَانِبُهُ : see لَيِّنٌ . -b2- لَانَ بَطْنُهُ His bowels became relaxed. -b3- لَانَ He relented.

headwords.def: inf. n. لِينٌ [not لَيْنٌ as in the CK] and لَياَنٌ, (T, S, M, K,) contr. of خَشُنَ; (S, K in art. خشن, and TK;) It was, or became, soft, as opposed to rough or harsh; smooth; plain; without asperities; fine to the touch; delicate; tender; supple; lithe; limber; pliant; pliable; flexible; ductile; malleable; soft, or flabby; lax: and he was, or became, soft; tender; pliant; gentle; bland; or mild. Hence لان جَانِبُهُ: see لَيِّنٌ. لَانَ بَطْنُهُ His bowels became relaxed.

لَايَنَهُ بِالقَوْلِ He soothed, coaxed, or wheedled, him with words. (L, art. مسح.) لَايَنَهُ [ He acted gently towards him; (M, K;) treated him with gentleness, or blandishment; soothed him; coaxed him; wheedled him; ] i. q. دَارَاهُ. (S, M, Msb, voce داراه.) لَايَنَهُ He was soft, tender, gentle, bland, or mild, towards him. (M, K.)
أَلَانَ بَطْنَهُ [ It relaxed his bowels ]; said of medicine. (K in art. سهل.)
for الْآنَ: see the latter in art. اين.
لِينُ العَيْشِ Softness, delicateness, or easiness, of life.
applied to a palm-tree: see art. لون; and see عَجْوَةٌ.
عَيْشٌ لَيِّنٌ Soft, delicate, or easy, life. لَيِّنُ الجَانِبِ: see جَانِبٌ. لَيِّنُ الأَعْطَافِ; &c.: see art. عطف.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
